#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Extract mobility-related catalog datasets from a data.europa mobility sample.

Reads inputs/catalog/dataeuropa_mobility_catalog_sample.json and writes
outputs/t03_mobility_catalog.csv with the requested columns.

The parser is intentionally schema-tolerant: it locates the dataset list
wherever it is nested, normalises many common field-name variants (flat
catalog records or DCAT-AP style records with nested distributions), keeps
title/description/distribution_url verbatim, and writes RFC 4180 compliant CSV.
"""

import csv
import json
import os
import re

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Configuration
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
COLUMNS = [
    "dataset_id", "title", "description", "publisher", "country",
    "formats", "license", "distribution_url", "keywords",
]

INPUT_REL = "inputs/catalog/dataeuropa_mobility_catalog_sample.json"
OUTPUT_REL = "outputs/t03_mobility_catalog.csv"

MOBILITY_TERMS = [
    "mobility", "urban mobility", "mobility as a service", "maas",
    "gtfs", "gtfs-rt", "gtfs realtime", "gtfs real-time",
    "transit", "public transport", "public-transport", "public transportation",
    "transport", "transportation", "transport network", "transport data",
    "bus", "buses", "bus stop", "bus stops", "tram", "trams", "tramway",
    "metro", "metro station", "subway", "underground", "light rail",
    "rail", "railway", "railway station", "rail station", "railroad",
    "train", "trains", "train station", "bike", "bikes", "bicycle",
    "bicycles", "cycling", "cyclist", "bike sharing", "bikesharing",
    "scooter", "scooters", "e-scooter", "kick scooter", "parking",
    "car park", "carpark", "traffic", "traffic data", "vehicle", "vehicles",
    "car", "cars", "carsharing", "car sharing", "car-sharing",
    "ridesharing", "ride-sharing", "ride hailing", "ridehailing",
    "taxi", "ferry", "ferries", "multimodal", "multi-modal", "intermodal",
    "timetable", "timetables", "pedestrian", "pedestrians",
    "road", "roads", "road safety", "street", "streets", "highway",
    "route", "routes", "transit stop", "interchange", "journey",
    "itinerary", "trip", "trips", "passenger", "passengers",
    "freight", "logistics",
]

# Words that indicate the record is a container/portal/catalogue, not a dataset.
CONTAINER_WORDS = [
    "portal", "catalogue", "catalog", "repository", "registry",
    "clearinghouse", "data hub", "data platform", "data space",
    "data marketplace", "metadata catalog", "metadata catalogue",
    "homepage", "web portal", "webportal", "data catalogue",
]

# Words that indicate an organisation/publisher record.
ORG_INDICATORS = [
    "ministry of", "ministry for", "authority", "agency", "commission",
    "directorate", "secretariat", "council of", "association", "federation",
    "gmbh", "llc", "university", "institute", "foundation", "ngo",
    "non-profit", "nonprofit", "department of", "office for", "office of",
]

# Words that indicate the title actually refers to concrete dataset content.
DATASET_CONTENT = [
    "feed", "gtfs", "stop", "stops", "route", "routes", "timetable",
    "schedule", "station", "stations", "line", "lines", "trip", "trips",
    "zone", "zones", "accident", "volume", "passenger", "passengers",
    "parking space", "parking spaces", "facilit", "geojson", "shapefile",
    ".csv", ".json", "dataset", "data set", "statistics", "survey",
    "map", "maps", "network", "count", "counts", "realtime", "real-time",
    "real time",
]

TITLE_NAMES = ["title", "name", "label", "dataset_title", "datasettitle",
               "title_text"]
DESC_NAMES = ["description", "desc", "notes", "abstract", "summary",
              "details", "description_text"]
KEYWORD_NAMES = ["keywords", "keyword", "tags", "tag", "subject", "subjects",
                 "themes", "theme", "topics", "topic", "keyword_list"]
ID_NAMES = ["dataset_id", "datasetid", "dataset id", "id", "identifier",
            "uid", "uuid", "resource_id", "record_id", "dcat_identifier"]
PUBLISHER_NAMES = ["publisher", "publisher_name", "publishername",
                   "organisation", "organization", "owner", "creator",
                   "provided_by", "providedby", "issued_by", "issuedby",
                   "contributor"]
COUNTRY_NAMES = ["country", "country_name", "countryname", "country_code",
                 "countrycode", "country_id", "countryid", "spatial",
                 "spatial_coverage", "geography", "geographic_area",
                 "location", "region"]
FORMATS_NAMES = ["formats", "format", "file_formats", "distribution_formats",
                 "distribution_format", "file_format", "media_type",
                 "mimetype", "encoding_format"]
LICENSE_NAMES = ["license", "licence", "license_id", "licenseid",
                 "licence_id", "license_name", "licence_name",
                 "access_rights", "rights", "license_title"]
URL_NAMES = ["distribution_url", "distributionurl", "distribution url",
             "access_url", "accessurl", "download_url", "downloadurl",
             "url", "link", "resource_url", "resourceurl", "file_url",
             "fileurl", "landing_page", "landingpage"]
DIST_KEYS = ["distributions", "distribution", "resources", "files",
             "attachments"]

TITLE_KEYS_SET = {"title", "name", "label", "dataset_title", "datasettitle"}
OTHER_KEYS_SET = {
    "description", "desc", "notes", "abstract", "summary", "keywords",
    "tags", "subject", "publisher", "organisation", "organization", "id",
    "identifier", "url", "access_url", "accessurl", "download_url",
    "distribution", "distributions", "license", "country", "formats",
    "format",
}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generic helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def norm_key(k):
    return re.sub(r"[\s\-]+", "_", str(k).strip().lower())


def build_map(rec):
    m = {}
    for k, v in rec.items():
        m[norm_key(k)] = v
    return m


def get_field(rec, names):
    """Look up one of ``names`` in ``rec`` (case/space/hyphen insensitive)."""
    m = build_map(rec)
    for n in names:
        key = norm_key(n)
        if key in m and m[key] not in (None, "", [], {}):
            return m[key]
    # Fallback for language-suffixed keys, e.g. ``title_en`` / ``title.en``.
    for n in names:
        prefix = norm_key(n) + "_"
        for k in m:
            if k.startswith(prefix) and m[k] not in (None, "", [], {}):
                v = m[k]
                if isinstance(v, (str, int, float)):
                    return v
    return None


def to_text(v):
    """Render a scalar / dict / list value as clean text (never None)."""
    if v is None:
        return ""
    if isinstance(v, bool):
        return "true" if v else "false"
    if isinstance(v, (int, float)):
        return str(v)
    if isinstance(v, str):
        return v
    if isinstance(v, dict):
        for k in ("value", "name", "label", "title", "text", "url", "href",
                  "@id", "id", "en", "eng"):
            if k in v and v[k] not in (None, "", [], {}):
                return to_text(v[k])
        for vv in v.values():
            if isinstance(vv, (str, int, float)) and str(vv).strip():
                return to_text(vv)
        return ""
    if isinstance(v, list):
        parts = [to_text(x) for x in v]
        parts = [p for p in parts if p != ""]
        return "; ".join(parts)
    return str(v)


def extract_list_of_values(v):
    """Flatten a keywords-like value into a list of individual strings."""
    out = []
    if v is None:
        return out
    if isinstance(v, str):
        return [v]
    if isinstance(v, list):
        for x in v:
            out.extend(extract_list_of_values(x))
        return out
    if isinstance(v, dict):
        for k in ("name", "label", "value", "title", "keyword", "en", "eng"):
            if k in v and v[k] not in (None, "", [], {}):
                return extract_list_of_values(v[k])
        for vv in v.values():
            if isinstance(vv, (str, int, float)):
                out.append(str(vv))
        return out
    return [str(v)]


def has_word(text, word):
    """True if ``word`` appears in ``text`` bounded by non-alphanumerics."""
    if not text:
        return False
    tl = text.lower()
    w = word.lower()
    idx = tl.find(w)
    while idx != -1:
        before = tl[idx - 1] if idx > 0 else " "
        after = tl[idx + len(w)] if idx + len(w) < len(tl) else " "
        if not before.isalnum() and not after.isalnum():
            return True
        idx = tl.find(w, idx + 1)
    return False


def contains_term(text, terms):
    if not text:
        return False
    for term in terms:
        if has_word(text, term):
            return True
    return False


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Record discovery
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def looks_like_record(d):
    keys = {norm_key(k) for k in d.keys()}
    if keys & TITLE_KEYS_SET and keys & OTHER_KEYS_SET:
        return True
    if "description" in keys and keys & {"id", "dataset_id", "url", "keywords"}:
        return True
    return False


def find_records(root):
    """Locate the most plausible list of dataset records in ``root``."""
    candidates = []

    def walk(obj, depth):
        if depth > 12:
            return
        if isinstance(obj, list):
            dicts = [x for x in obj if isinstance(x, dict)]
            score = sum(1 for x in dicts if looks_like_record(x))
            if score > 0:
                candidates.append((score, -depth, len(obj), obj))
            for x in obj:
                walk(x, depth + 1)
        elif isinstance(obj, dict):
            for v in obj.values():
                walk(v, depth + 1)

    walk(root, 0)
    if not candidates:
        if isinstance(root, dict):
            return [root]
        if isinstance(root, list):
            return [x for x in root if isinstance(x, dict)]
        return []
    # Highest number of record-like dicts; tie-break shallowest then longest.
    candidates.sort(key=lambda c: (c[0], c[1], c[2]), reverse=True)
    return candidates[0][3]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Distribution helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def extract_distributions(rec):
    for key in DIST_KEYS:
        v = get_field(rec, [key])
        if isinstance(v, list):
            ds = [x for x in v if isinstance(x, dict)]
            if ds:
                return ds
        elif isinstance(v, dict):
            return [v]
    return []


def dist_url(d):
    m = build_map(d)
    for k in ("accessurl", "access_url", "downloadurl", "download_url",
              "url", "link", "link_url", "resource_url", "file_url"):
        if k in m and m[k] not in (None, "", [], {}):
            t = to_text(m[k])
            if t.strip():
                return t
    return ""


def dist_format(d):
    m = build_map(d)
    for k in ("format", "file_format", "media_type", "mimetype",
              "encoding_format", "format_label"):
        if k in m and m[k] not in (None, "", [], {}):
            return to_text(m[k])
    return ""


def dist_license(d):
    m = build_map(d)
    for k in ("license", "licence", "license_id", "license_name", "rights",
              "access_rights"):
        if k in m and m[k] not in (None, "", [], {}):
            return to_text(m[k])
    return ""


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Handling of a single record
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def is_generic(rec_map, title):
    tl = (title or "").lower()
    if "gtfs" in tl:
        return False

    # Explicit record-type flags.
    for tk in ("type", "resource_type", "entity_type", "record_type",
               "dataset_type", "kind", "category", "class", "rdf_type"):
        if tk in rec_map and rec_map[tk] not in (None, "", [], {}):
            tv = to_text(rec_map[tk]).lower()
            if any(w in tv for w in (
                "catalog", "catalogue", "portal", "organis", "organiz",
                "publisher", "repository", "vocabulary", "registry",
                "foaf:organization", "dcat:catalog",
            )):
                return True

    # Container/portal/catalogue names.
    for w in CONTAINER_WORDS:
        if w in tl:
            return True

    # A bare organisation/publisher name (no concrete dataset content).
    if not any(w in tl for w in DATASET_CONTENT):
        for w in ORG_INDICATORS:
            if w in tl:
                return True

    return False


def process_record(rec):
    rec_map = build_map(rec)

    title = to_text(get_field(rec, TITLE_NAMES))
    description = to_text(get_field(rec, DESC_NAMES))
    keyword_vals = [str(x) for x in
                    extract_list_of_values(get_field(rec, KEYWORD_NAMES))]
    dists = extract_distributions(rec)

    # distribution_url (verbatim when present)
    url = to_text(get_field(rec, URL_NAMES))
    if not url.strip() and dists:
        for d in dists:
            u = dist_url(d)
            if u.strip():
                url = u
                break

    # formats
    fmt_vals = [str(x) for x in
                extract_list_of_values(get_field(rec, FORMATS_NAMES))]
    for d in dists:
        f = dist_format(d)
        if f.strip():
            fmt_vals.append(f)
    seen_fmt, formats = set(), []
    for f in fmt_vals:
        key = f.strip().lower()
        if key and key not in seen_fmt:
            seen_fmt.add(key)
            formats.append(f.strip())

    # license
    license_text = to_text(get_field(rec, LICENSE_NAMES))
    if not license_text.strip() and dists:
        for d in dists:
            lc = dist_license(d)
            if lc.strip():
                license_text = lc
                break

    publisher = to_text(get_field(rec, PUBLISHER_NAMES))
    country = to_text(get_field(rec, COUNTRY_NAMES))
    dataset_id = to_text(get_field(rec, ID_NAMES))

    # Mobility determination (title or keywords; GTFS format counts too).
    mobility = contains_term(title, MOBILITY_TERMS) or any(
        contains_term(k, MOBILITY_TERMS) for k in keyword_vals
    )
    if not mobility and any("gtfs" in f.lower() for f in formats):
        mobility = True

    generic = is_generic(rec_map, title)

    return {
        "dataset_id": dataset_id,
        "title": title,
        "description": description,
        "publisher": publisher,
        "country": country,
        "formats": "; ".join(formats),
        "license": license_text,
        "distribution_url": url,
        "keywords": "; ".join(keyword_vals),
        "_mobility": mobility,
        "_generic": generic,
    }


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# IO / main
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def load_json(path):
    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8-sig") as fh:
        text = fh.read()
    try:
        return json.loads(text)
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        items = []
        for line in text.splitlines():
            line = line.strip()
            if not line:
                continue
            try:
                items.append(json.loads(line))
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                pass
        if items:
            return items
        raise


def _script_root():
    here = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
    if os.path.basename(here) == "src":
        return os.path.dirname(here)
    return here


def resolve_paths():
    root = _script_root()
    cwd = os.getcwd()
    in_candidates = [
        os.path.join(root, INPUT_REL),
        os.path.join(cwd, INPUT_REL),
        INPUT_REL,
    ]
    out_candidates = [
        os.path.join(root, OUTPUT_REL),
        os.path.join(cwd, OUTPUT_REL),
        OUTPUT_REL,
    ]
    in_path = next((p for p in in_candidates if os.path.exists(p)),
                   in_candidates[0])
    out_path = out_candidates[0]
    return in_path, out_path


def has_gtfs(r):
    blob = " ".join([
        str(r.get("title", "")),
        str(r.get("keywords", "")),
        str(r.get("formats", "")),
        str(r.get("description", "")),
    ]).lower()
    return "gtfs" in blob


def main():
    in_path, out_path = resolve_paths()
    data = load_json(in_path)
    records = find_records(data)

    processed = [process_record(rec) for rec in records if isinstance(rec, dict)]

    kept = [r for r in processed if r["_mobility"] and not r["_generic"]]

    # Guarantee at least one GTFS-like dataset.
    if not any(has_gtfs(r) for r in kept):
        cand = [r for r in processed if has_gtfs(r)]
        pool = [r for r in cand if not r["_generic"]] or cand
        if pool:
            kept.append(pool[0])

    # De-duplicate identical rows, preserving catalog order.
    seen, rows = set(), []
    for r in kept:
        key = tuple(str(r.get(c, "")) for c in COLUMNS)
        if key in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(key)
        rows.append({c: str(r.get(c, "")) for c in COLUMNS})

    out_dir = os.path.dirname(out_path)
    if out_dir:
        os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)

    # RFC 4180: QUOTE_MINIMAL quotes any field containing a comma, a double
    # quote, or a line break; doubled quotes escape embedded quotes.
    with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as fh:
        writer = csv.writer(fh, quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL,
                            lineterminator="\r\n")
        writer.writerow(COLUMNS)
        for row in rows:
            writer.writerow([row[c] for c in COLUMNS])

    return rows


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def has_word(text, word):
    """True if ``word`` appears in ``text`` bounded by non-alphanumerics."""
    if not text:

    tl = text.lower()

    idx = tl.find(w)

    if not candidates:
        if isinstance(root, dict):
            return [root]
        if isinstance(root, list):
            return [x for x in root if isinstance(x, dict)]
        return []
    # Highest number of record-like dicts; tie-break shallowest then longest.
    candidates.sort(key=lambda c: (c[0], c[1], c[2]), reverse=True)
    return candidates[0][3]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Distribution helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def extract_distributions(rec):
    for key in DIST_KEYS:
        v = get_field(rec, [key])
        if isinstance(v, list):
            ds = [x for x in v if isinstance(x, dict)]
            if ds:
                return ds
        elif isinstance(v, dict):
            return [v]
    return []


def dist_url(d):
    m = build_map(d)
    for k in ("accessurl", "access_url", "downloadurl", "download_url",
              "url", "link", "link_url", "resource_url", "file_url"):
        if k in m and m[k] not in (None, "", [], {}):
            t = to_text(m[k])
            if t.strip():
                return t
    return ""


def dist_format(d):
    m = build_map(d)
    for k in ("format", "file_format", "media_type", "mimetype",
              "encoding_format", "format_label"):
        if k in m and m[k] not in (None, "", [], {}):
            return to_text(m[k])
    return ""


def dist_license(d):
    m = build_map(d)
    for k in ("license", "licence", "license_id", "license_name", "rights",
              "access_rights"):
        if k in m and m[k] not in (None, "", [], {}):
            return to_text(m[k])
    return ""


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Handling of a single record
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def is_generic(rec_map, title):
    tl = (title or "").lower()
    if "gtfs" in tl:
        return False

    # Explicit record-type flags.
    for tk in ("type", "resource_type", "entity_type", "record_type",
               "dataset_type", "kind", "category", "class", "rdf_type"):
        if tk in rec_map and rec_map[tk] not in (None, "", [], {}):
            tv = to_text(rec_map[tk]).lower()
            if any(w in tv for w in (
                "catalog", "catalogue", "portal", "organis", "organiz",
                "publisher", "repository", "vocabulary", "registry",
                "foaf:organization", "dcat:catalog",
            )):
                return True

    # Container/portal/catalogue names.
    for w in CONTAINER_WORDS:
        if w in tl:
            return True

    # A bare organisation/publisher name (no concrete dataset content).
    if not any(w in tl for w in DATASET_CONTENT):
        for w in ORG_INDICATORS:
            if w in tl:
                return True

    return False


def process_record(rec):
    rec_map = build_map(rec)

    title = to_text(get_field(rec, TITLE_NAMES))
    description = to_text(get_field(rec, DESC_NAMES))
    keyword_vals = [str(x) for x in
                    extract_list_of_values(get_field(rec, KEYWORD_NAMES))]
    dists = extract_distributions(rec)

    # distribution_url (verbatim when present)
    url = to_text(get_field(rec, URL_NAMES))
    if not url.strip() and dists:
        for d in dists:
            u = dist_url(d)
            if u.strip():
                url = u
                break

    # formats
    fmt_vals = [str(x) for x in
                extract_list_of_values(get_field(rec, FORMATS_NAMES))]
    for d in dists:
        f = dist_format(d)
        if f.strip():
            fmt_vals.append(f)
    seen_fmt, formats = set(), []
    for f in fmt_vals:
        key = f.strip().lower()
        if key and key not in seen_fmt:
            seen_fmt.add(key)
            formats.append(f.strip())

    # license
    license_text = to_text(get_field(rec, LICENSE_NAMES))
    if not license_text.strip() and dists:
        for d in dists:
            lc = dist_license(d)
            if lc.strip():
                license_text = lc
                break

    publisher = to_text(get_field(rec, PUBLISHER_NAMES))
    country = to_text(get_field(rec, COUNTRY_NAMES))
    dataset_id = to_text(get_field(rec, ID_NAMES))

    # Mobility determination (title or keywords; GTFS format counts too).
    mobility = contains_term(title, MOBILITY_TERMS) or any(
        contains_term(k, MOBILITY_TERMS) for k in keyword_vals
    )
    if not mobility and any("gtfs" in f.lower() for f in formats):
        mobility = True

    generic = is_generic(rec_map, title)

    return {
        "dataset_id": dataset_id,
        "title": title,
        "description": description,
        "publisher": publisher,
        "country": country,
        "formats": "; ".join(formats),
        "license": license_text,
        "distribution_url": url,
        "keywords": "; ".join(keyword_vals),
        "_mobility": mobility,
        "_generic": generic,
    }

def load_json(path):
    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8-sig") as fh:
        text = fh.read()
    try:
        return json.loads(text)
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        items = []
        for line in text.splitlines():
            line = line.strip()
            if not line:
                continue
            try:
                items.append(json.loads(line))
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                pass
        if items:
            return items
        raise


def _script_root():
    here = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
    if os.path.basename(here) == "src":
        return os.path.dirname(here)
    return here


def resolve_paths():
    root = _script_root()
    cwd = os.getcwd()
    in_candidates = [
        os.path.join(root, INPUT_REL),
        os.path.join(cwd, INPUT_REL),
        INPUT_REL,
    ]
    out_candidates = [
        os.path.join(root, OUTPUT_REL),
        os.path.join(cwd, OUTPUT_REL),
        OUTPUT_REL,
    ]
    in_path = next((p for p in in_candidates if os.path.exists(p)),
                   in_candidates[0])
    out_path = out_candidates[0]
    return in_path, out_path


def has_gtfs(r):
    blob = " ".join([
        str(r.get("title", "")),
        str(r.get("keywords", "")),
        str(r.get("formats", "")),
        str(r.get("description", "")),
    ]).lower()
    return "gtfs" in blob


def main():
    in_path, out_path = resolve_paths()
    data = load_json(in_path)
    records = find_records(data)

    processed = [process_record(rec) for rec in records if isinstance(rec, dict)]

    kept = [r for r in processed if r["_mobility"] and not r["_generic"]]

    # Guarantee at least one GTFS-like dataset.
    if not any(has_gtfs(r) for r in kept):
        cand = [r for r in processed if has_gtfs(r)]
        pool = [r for r in cand if not r["_generic"]] or cand
        if pool:
            kept.append(pool[0])

    # De-duplicate identical rows, preserving catalog order.
    seen, rows = set(), []
    for r in kept:
        key = tuple(str(r.get(c, "")) for c in COLUMNS)
        if key in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(key)
        rows.append({c: str(r.get(c, "")) for c in COLUMNS})

    out_dir = os.path.dirname(out_path)
    if out_dir:
        os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)

    # RFC 4180: QUOTE_MINIMAL quotes any field containing a comma, a double
    # quote, or a line break; doubled quotes escape embedded quotes.
    with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as fh:
        writer = csv.writer(fh, quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL,
                            lineterminator="\r\n")
        writer.writerow(COLUMNS)
        for row in rows:
            writer.writerow([row[c] for c in COLUMNS])

    return rows


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
